senses.en: the fact that something does not exist; lack
senses.pattern: in the absence of / the absence of evidence / a complete absence of
senses.example: In the [[absence]] of clear evidence, the judge refused to send the young man to prison.
senses.example_zh: 由於缺乏明確的證據，法官拒絕將這名年輕人送進監獄。
senses.note: in the absence of 意為「在沒有…的情況下」

gsat.sentence: The [[absence]] of smiles stemmed partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by poor dental hygiene.
However, with the [[absence]] of gravity in the outer space, our body fluids redistribute, shifting toward the upper body and the head.

senses.en: a particular manner, appearance, or feeling
senses.pattern: an air of confidence / an air of mystery / with an air of authority
senses.example: The new coach walked into the gym with an [[air]] of quiet confidence that calmed the players.
senses.example_zh: 新教練帶著沉穩自信的神態走進體育館，讓球員們安心下來。
senses.note: put on airs 意為「擺架子」

senses.en: to broadcast a program, or to be broadcast
senses.pattern: air a show / air live / be aired on television
senses.example: The documentary about sea turtles will [[air]] on public television next Sunday evening at eight.
senses.example_zh: 這部關於海龜的紀錄片將於下週日晚間八點在公共電視播出。
senses.note: on (the) air 意為「播出中」

senses.en: to want a particular amount of money for something
senses.pattern: ask $500 for sth / ask a high price / ask too much for sth
senses.example: The seller is [[asking]] eight thousand dollars for the used scooter, but I think it is worth half.
senses.example_zh: 賣家對這輛二手機車開價八千元，但我覺得它只值一半。
senses.note: asking price 即「開價」

senses.en: to expect or demand something from someone
senses.pattern: ask a lot of sb / ask too much of sb / be too much to ask
senses.example: The coach [[asks]] a great deal of her swimmers, who train twice a day even in winter.
senses.example_zh: 教練對她的游泳選手要求很高，他們連冬天也一天訓練兩次。
senses.note: 句型為 ask sth of sb

senses.en: to smile very happily
senses.pattern: beam with pride / beam at sb / beam with joy
senses.example: The little girl [[beamed]] with pride when her painting was hung in the school hallway.
senses.example_zh: 小女孩的畫被掛在學校走廊時，她驕傲得笑容滿面。

senses.en: a long heavy piece of wood or metal supporting a roof
senses.pattern: a wooden beam / a steel beam / roof beams
senses.example: Workers replaced the cracked wooden [[beams]] so that the old temple roof would not fall in.
senses.example_zh: 工人換掉了龜裂的木頭橫梁，以免古廟的屋頂塌下來。

gsat.sentence: She would [[beam]] and put it in her best crystal vase.
Placed along the rear or front walls of a house, house poles also helped to support the main [[beam]] of the roof.

senses.en: to have something impressive that one can be proud of
senses.pattern: boast a long history / boast beautiful beaches / boast a fine collection
senses.example: With over three hundred sunny days a year, the coastal city [[boasts]] the best weather in the country.
senses.example_zh: 這座濱海城市一年有三百多天放晴，擁有全國最好的天氣。
senses.note: 主詞多為地方或事物，不用被動

gsat.sentence: Aside from handcrafted beer, the menu [[boasts]] hand-made gourmet pizzas such as the Yummy Duck n’ Cheese, loaded with roast duck and, yes, creamy delicious cheese.

senses.en: a person applying for a job or being considered for it
senses.pattern: a job candidate / interview candidates / a suitable candidate for the post
senses.example: After interviewing twelve [[candidates]], the manager offered the job to a recent graduate with no experience.
senses.example_zh: 面試了十二位應徵者之後，經理把這份工作給了一位毫無經驗的應屆畢業生。
senses.note: 也可指考試的「應試者」

senses.en: a person or thing suitable for or likely to get something
senses.pattern: a good candidate for surgery / a prime candidate for / a likely candidate
senses.example: Doctors say that patients who are otherwise healthy are the best [[candidates]] for this kind of knee surgery.
senses.example_zh: 醫師表示，其他方面都健康的病人是最適合接受這種膝蓋手術的對象。
senses.note: 常用 a candidate for…

gsat.sentence: Since Michael was the best [[candidate]], the committee voted unanimously for him to take charge of the company’s sales department.

senses.en: a letter, number, or symbol used in writing or computing
senses.pattern: Chinese characters / a password of eight characters / special characters
senses.example: Your password must contain at least eight [[characters]], including one number and one capital letter.
senses.example_zh: 你的密碼必須至少包含八個字元，其中要有一個數字和一個大寫字母。

senses.en: strong moral qualities such as honesty and courage
senses.pattern: build character / a person of character / strength of character
senses.example: Our principal believes that doing volunteer work builds [[character]] far better than any lecture can.
senses.example_zh: 我們校長認為，做志工比任何說教更能培養品格。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

senses.en: to fail suddenly and completely
senses.pattern: the economy collapses / the talks collapsed / the company collapsed
senses.example: The country's banking system nearly [[collapsed]] during the crisis, and thousands of families lost their savings.
senses.example_zh: 該國的銀行體系在那場危機中幾乎崩潰，數千個家庭失去了積蓄。
senses.note: 也可作名詞：economic collapse

senses.en: to fall down suddenly because of illness or tiredness
senses.pattern: collapse from exhaustion / collapse on the floor / collapse into a chair
senses.example: One runner [[collapsed]] from the heat just ten meters before the finish line and was rushed to the hospital.
senses.example_zh: 一名跑者在終點線前僅十公尺處因高溫而昏倒，隨即被緊急送醫。

gsat.sentence: The kingdom began to [[collapse]] after the death of its ruler, and was soon taken over by a neighboring country.
As Deborah shuffled sideways to block the player, her knee went out and she [[collapsed]] on the court in burning pain.

senses.en: an illness or health problem, often a lasting one
senses.pattern: a heart condition / a medical condition / a skin condition / a rare condition
senses.example: Because of a heart [[condition]], my grandfather has to take medicine every morning and avoid salty food.
senses.example_zh: 因為心臟疾病，我爺爺每天早上都得吃藥，並且避免吃太鹹的食物。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞

senses.en: to train someone to think or behave in a certain way
senses.pattern: be conditioned to do sth / be conditioned by society / condition sb to accept sth
senses.example: Years of advertising have [[conditioned]] shoppers to believe that a higher price always means better quality.
senses.example_zh: 多年來的廣告已使消費者習慣於相信，價格越高品質一定越好。
senses.note: 多用被動 be conditioned to V

gsat.sentence: Synesthesia is a [[condition]] in which people’s senses intermix.
While the twins knew that genetics might have played a role in their [[condition]], they recognized that their eating habits might have also contributed to their heart problems.

senses.en: to join or combine one thing with another
senses.pattern: coupled with sth / couple A with B / be closely coupled to sth
senses.example: Heavy rain, [[coupled]] with strong winds, forced the airport to cancel more than fifty flights.
senses.example_zh: 豪雨加上強風，迫使機場取消了五十多個航班。
senses.note: 多用被動 coupled with…

senses.en: very important to someone; greatly valued
senses.pattern: be dear to sb / dear to sb's heart / hold sth dear
senses.example: This old wooden piano is very [[dear]] to my mother because her father made it by hand.
senses.example_zh: 這架老舊的木製鋼琴對我母親來說非常珍貴，因為那是她父親親手做的。
senses.note: 常用 be dear to sb

senses.en: costing a lot of money; expensive
senses.pattern: far too dear / rather dear / get dearer
senses.example: Fresh vegetables have become so [[dear]] this winter that many families are buying frozen ones instead.
senses.example_zh: 今年冬天新鮮蔬菜變得很昂貴，許多家庭改買冷凍蔬菜。
senses.note: 主要為英式用法；副詞 dearly 代價慘重地

senses.en: (of problems) to follow and trouble someone for a long time
senses.pattern: be dogged by injury / be dogged by bad luck / dog sb's footsteps
senses.example: The talented pitcher has been [[dogged]] by shoulder injuries ever since he joined the team.
senses.example_zh: 這位有天分的投手自從加入球隊後，就一直受肩傷困擾。
senses.note: 多用被動 be dogged by…

senses.en: a small amount of a quality or feeling
senses.pattern: an element of truth / an element of risk / an element of surprise / an element of luck
senses.example: There is always an [[element]] of risk in starting a business, however carefully you plan.
senses.example_zh: 無論計畫得多仔細，創業總是帶有些許風險。
senses.note: be in one's element 如魚得水

senses.en: the weather, especially wind, rain, and cold
senses.pattern: be exposed to the elements / brave the elements / shelter from the elements
senses.example: The hikers built a simple shelter of branches to protect themselves from the [[elements]] overnight.
senses.example_zh: 登山客用樹枝搭了一個簡單的遮蔽處，好在夜裡抵擋風雨。
senses.note: 恆用 the elements

senses.en: clearly and deliberately stated
senses.pattern: express permission / express purpose / express wish / express consent
senses.example: The fund was set up with the [[express]] purpose of helping students from remote villages attend university.
senses.example_zh: 這筆基金的設立有個明確的目的，就是幫助偏鄉學生上大學。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；副詞 expressly

senses.en: travelling or delivered very quickly
senses.pattern: an express train / express delivery / an express bus / by express mail
senses.example: If you take the [[express]] train, you can reach the airport from downtown in under forty minutes.
senses.example_zh: 如果搭特快列車，你從市中心到機場不用四十分鐘。
senses.note: 也可作名詞，指「快車；快遞」

senses.en: a state of great excitement about something
senses.pattern: gold fever / World Cup fever / baseball fever / at fever pitch
senses.example: Soccer [[fever]] swept the whole country when the national team reached the final for the first time.
senses.example_zh: 國家隊首度打進決賽時，足球熱潮席捲全國。
senses.note: 常接在名詞之後，如 gold fever

gsat.sentence: Over 100,000 people with “gold [[fever]]” made this trip hoping to become millionaires.
“gold [[fever]]” was not worth the lives of many people

senses.en: a particular arrangement or pattern of people or things
senses.pattern: fly in formation / in a V formation / a battle formation / march in close formation
senses.example: Every autumn, wild geese fly south in a V [[formation]] to save energy on the long journey.
senses.example_zh: 每年秋天，野雁排成 V 字隊形南飛，以便在長途飛行中節省體力。
senses.note: in formation 意為「排成隊形」

senses.en: something naturally formed, such as rocks or clouds
senses.pattern: rock formations / cloud formations / a limestone formation / coral formations
senses.example: Tourists come from around the world to photograph the strange rock [[formations]] along this stretch of coast.
senses.example_zh: 世界各地的遊客前來拍攝這段海岸沿線奇特的岩石構造。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞

senses.en: benefit or advantage to someone or something
senses.pattern: do sb good / for your own good / do more harm than good / the common good
senses.example: A week of rest in the countryside will do you a lot of [[good]] after such a stressful semester.
senses.example_zh: 經過壓力這麼大的一學期，到鄉下休息一週會對你大有好處。
senses.note: for good 意為「永遠」，勿混淆

senses.en: valid; able to be used for a stated period
senses.pattern: be good for one year / good until the end of May / good for two people
senses.example: This rail pass is [[good]] for seven days and can be used on any train in the country.
senses.example_zh: 這張鐵路周遊券七天內有效，可搭乘國內任何一班火車。

senses.en: at least a stated amount; fairly large
senses.pattern: a good two hours / a good ten kilometers / a good many / a good deal of
senses.example: It took us a [[good]] three hours to reach the lake because the mountain road was so narrow.
senses.example_zh: 因為山路非常狹窄，我們足足花了三個小時才抵達湖邊。
senses.note: 句型為 a good＋數量

senses.en: to do what one has promised or agreed to
senses.pattern: honor a promise / honor an agreement / honor a contract / honor a commitment
senses.example: Whatever happens next season, the club must [[honor]] the three-year contract it signed with the coach.
senses.example_zh: 無論下個球季情況如何，球隊都必須履行與教練簽下的三年合約。
senses.note: 英式拼法為 honour

senses.en: a high level of achievement in school or university studies
senses.pattern: graduate with honors / with highest honors / an honors student
senses.example: She graduated from medical school with [[honors]] and was soon offered a position at a teaching hospital.
senses.example_zh: 她以優異成績從醫學院畢業，不久就獲得一家教學醫院的職位。
senses.note: 恆用複數 honors

gsat.sentence: Although Jeffery had to keep two part-time jobs to support his family, he never neglected his studies. In fact, he graduated with [[honors]].

senses.en: to make something unpleasant more likely to happen
senses.pattern: invite trouble / invite criticism / invite disaster / invite danger
senses.example: Posting your home address online is [[inviting]] trouble, so think twice before you share it.
senses.example_zh: 在網路上公開住家地址等於是招惹麻煩，分享之前務必三思。

senses.en: to formally ask for comments, questions, or applications
senses.pattern: invite questions / invite comments / invite applications / invite suggestions
senses.example: The city government is [[inviting]] suggestions from residents on how to redesign the riverside park.
senses.example_zh: 市政府正在向居民徵求重新設計河濱公園的建議。

gsat.sentence: To bring the evil eye into the home is thus believed to [[invite]] trouble and sorrow.

senses.en: knowledge gained through study and reading
senses.pattern: a man of learning / a woman of great learning / book learning
senses.example: The old professor was respected not only for his great [[learning]] but also for his kindness to students.
senses.example_zh: 這位老教授受人敬重，不僅因為他學識淵博，也因為他對學生很親切。
senses.note: 形容詞 learned /ˈlɝnɪd/ 博學的

senses.en: the different parts or people that form something
senses.pattern: genetic makeup / chemical makeup / the makeup of the team
senses.example: The [[makeup]] of the national team has changed a lot, with six new players under twenty.
senses.example_zh: 國家隊的成員組成改變很大，有六名二十歲以下的新球員。
senses.note: 也拼作 make-up

senses.en: a test taken later to replace a missed one
senses.pattern: a makeup exam / a makeup test / take a makeup
senses.example: Students who missed the midterm because of the flu may take a [[makeup]] next Friday afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 因流感而錯過期中考的學生，可以在下週五下午參加補考。
senses.note: 美式用法；makeup class 指「補課」

senses.en: a person who is not yet legally an adult
senses.pattern: sell alcohol to minors / protect minors / be still a minor
senses.example: It is against the law for stores to sell cigarettes or alcohol to [[minors]].
senses.example_zh: 商店販售香菸或酒類給未成年人是違法的。

senses.en: a second subject studied at college besides the main one
senses.pattern: a minor in music / choose a minor / with a minor in history
senses.example: She is majoring in biology with a [[minor]] in Japanese, hoping to do research in Kyoto someday.
senses.example_zh: 她主修生物，副修科目是日文，希望有朝一日能到京都做研究。
senses.note: 動詞用法：minor in… 副修…

senses.en: to get over or through a difficult place successfully
senses.pattern: negotiate a sharp bend / negotiate the stairs / negotiate rough ground
senses.example: The bus driver slowed down to [[negotiate]] a series of sharp bends on the mountain road.
senses.example_zh: 公車司機放慢速度，以順利通過山路上一連串的急彎。

gsat.sentence: But baby elephants, not used to [[negotiating]] rough ground, may easily fall into the trenches and get hurt; and once injured, they might not be able to climb out.

senses.en: a planned activity involving many people, such as soldiers or rescuers
senses.pattern: a rescue operation / a military operation / a police operation / launch an operation
senses.example: More than two hundred volunteers joined the rescue [[operation]] after the earthquake struck the village.
senses.example_zh: 地震襲擊村莊後，兩百多名志工加入了救援行動。

senses.en: the working or running of a business or system
senses.pattern: begin operation / be in operation / come into operation / business operations
senses.example: The new subway line will begin [[operation]] next spring, cutting travel time to the airport by half.
senses.example_zh: 新的地鐵路線將於明年春天開始營運，讓前往機場的時間減半。
senses.note: in operation 意為「運作中」

gsat.sentence: If student enrollment continues to drop, some programs at the university may be eliminated to reduce the [[operation]] costs.
But trading online is gaining popularity these days, with several sites in [[operation]], including HomeExchanges.

senses.en: very careful about what one chooses; hard to please
senses.pattern: be particular about food / be very particular about sth / particular about what one wears
senses.example: The hotel's chefs are very [[particular]] about where their vegetables come from and visit the farms themselves.
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店的主廚對蔬菜的來源非常講究，還會親自到農場查看。
senses.note: 句型為 be particular about…

senses.en: the details or facts about something, especially written ones
senses.pattern: the particulars of the case / give full particulars / take down sb's particulars
senses.example: The police officer wrote down the [[particulars]] of the accident before letting both drivers go.
senses.example_zh: 警察記下這起事故的詳情後，才讓兩位駕駛離開。
senses.note: 恆用複數 particulars

senses.en: with nothing added, or without pattern or decoration
senses.pattern: plain water / plain yogurt / plain rice / a plain white shirt
senses.example: I prefer [[plain]] yogurt with fresh fruit to the sweetened kind sold in most supermarkets.
senses.example_zh: 比起多數超市賣的加糖優格，我比較喜歡原味優格配新鮮水果。
senses.note: plain water 即「白開水」

senses.en: easy to see or understand; clear
senses.pattern: make it plain that / in plain English / plain to see / the plain truth
senses.example: The teacher made it [[plain]] that late homework would no longer be accepted for any reason.
senses.example_zh: 老師明白表示，無論任何理由都不再收遲交的作業。
senses.note: 副詞 plainly 清楚地；顯然

gsat.sentence: Replacing lost fluid with just [[plain]] water means the body has too much water and not enough salt.

The team has also developed a special device which uses scent bottles and visual trickery to make the wearers of these glasses think that the [[plain]] snack they are eating is tastier than it actually is.

senses.en: an impressive manner that makes people notice someone
senses.pattern: stage presence / a commanding presence / have great presence
senses.example: Although the singer is only sixteen, her stage [[presence]] holds the attention of every person in the hall.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手雖然才十六歲，她的舞台風采卻能吸引全場每個人的目光。

senses.en: a person or thing that is present somewhere
senses.pattern: a familiar presence / a calming presence / a constant presence
senses.example: The friendly old guard has been a familiar [[presence]] at the school gate for over twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 這位親切的老警衛二十多年來一直是校門口大家熟悉的身影。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞

senses.en: a group of soldiers or police stationed in a place
senses.pattern: a police presence / a military presence / a heavy security presence
senses.example: There was a heavy police [[presence]] around the stadium to keep order during the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽期間，體育場周圍有大批警力駐守以維持秩序。
senses.note: 此義常用單數

gsat.sentence: Whether they wielded rods or pea shooters, knockers-up became familiar [[presences]] throughout the United Kingdom.

senses.en: to intend to do something
senses.pattern: propose to do sth / propose doing sth / how do you propose to do sth
senses.example: How do you [[propose]] to finish the science project on time if you keep putting it off?
senses.example_zh: 如果你一直拖延，你打算怎麼準時完成這個科學專題？
senses.note: 較正式；後接 to V 或 V-ing

senses.en: to ask someone to marry you
senses.pattern: propose to sb / propose to one's girlfriend / propose on one knee
senses.example: He [[proposed]] to his girlfriend on the beach where they had first met five years earlier.
senses.example_zh: 他在五年前兩人初次相遇的海灘上向女友求婚。
senses.note: 名詞 proposal 也可指「求婚」

senses.zh: 祕訣；（導致某結果的）因素
senses.en: a way or situation likely to lead to a particular result
senses.pattern: a recipe for success / a recipe for disaster / a recipe for happiness
senses.example: Hard work, patience, and a little luck are her [[recipe]] for success in the publishing business.
senses.example_zh: 努力、耐心加上一點運氣，就是她在出版業的成功祕訣。
senses.note: a recipe for disaster 必釀成災禍的做法

senses.en: a quiet, private place where one goes to rest
senses.pattern: a mountain retreat / a country retreat / a peaceful retreat / a retreat from the city
senses.example: The writer bought a small cabin by the lake as a [[retreat]] from the noise of the city.
senses.example_zh: 這位作家買下湖邊的一間小木屋，作為遠離城市喧囂的僻靜處。

senses.en: a period spent away for quiet thought or prayer
senses.pattern: go on a retreat / a meditation retreat / a weekend retreat
senses.example: After the exams, she joined a ten-day meditation [[retreat]] in the mountains, with no phone or internet.
senses.example_zh: 考完試後，她到山裡參加為期十天的冥想靜修，期間不用手機也不上網。
senses.note: 公司或團體的 retreat 指「共識營」

senses.en: the right to take part in deciding something
senses.pattern: have a say in sth / have no say / have the final say
senses.example: Students should have a [[say]] in choosing the destination of their own graduation trip.
senses.example_zh: 學生對於自己畢業旅行的地點應該有發言權。
senses.note: have the final say 有最後決定權

senses.en: used to give an example or a possible amount
senses.pattern: say, ten minutes / let's say / in, say, three years
senses.example: If you save, [[say]], fifty dollars a week, you can buy the guitar before summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 如果你每週存一點錢，比方說五十元，暑假前就能買下那把吉他。
senses.note: 作插入語，前後常有逗號

senses.en: a religious ceremony, especially in a church
senses.pattern: a memorial service / a funeral service / attend a service / a Sunday service
senses.example: Hundreds of villagers attended the memorial [[service]] held for the fishermen lost in the storm.
senses.example_zh: 數百位村民參加了為暴風雨中罹難漁民舉行的追思儀式。

senses.en: to examine and repair a vehicle or machine regularly
senses.pattern: service a car / have the air conditioner serviced / be regularly serviced
senses.example: You should have your scooter [[serviced]] every six months to make sure the brakes work properly.
senses.example_zh: 你應該每六個月把機車送去保養一次，以確保煞車運作正常。
senses.note: 常用 have＋物＋serviced

senses.en: work or time spent in the armed forces or government
senses.pattern: military service / do one's military service / public service / years of service
senses.example: After two years of military [[service]], he returned home and opened a small repair shop.
senses.example_zh: 服完兩年兵役後，他回到家鄉開了一間小修理店。
senses.note: military service 即「兵役」

gsat.sentence: In some countries, military [[service]] is compulsory for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.

senses.en: to fall to a lower level; to become sad
senses.pattern: sb's heart sinks / sink to a record low / sink into despair / prices sink
senses.example: My heart [[sank]] when I saw the long line of people waiting outside the ticket office.
senses.example_zh: 看到售票處外大排長龍，我的心頓時一沉，心情低落下來。
senses.note: 三態 sink–sank–sunk

senses.en: to put a lot of money into a business or project
senses.pattern: sink money into sth / sink one's savings into sth / sink millions into sth
senses.example: The couple [[sank]] all their savings into a small café that closed within a year.
senses.example_zh: 這對夫妻把所有積蓄都投入一家小咖啡館，結果不到一年就關門了。
senses.note: 句型為 sink＋錢＋into…

senses.en: to arrange things with regular gaps between them
senses.pattern: be evenly spaced / space sth out / be widely spaced / be spaced one meter apart
senses.example: During the exam, the desks were [[spaced]] one meter apart so that no one could look at another's paper.
senses.example_zh: 考試時，課桌以一公尺的間隔排列，讓大家無法偷看別人的考卷。
senses.note: 常用被動，如 evenly spaced

senses.en: a period of time
senses.pattern: in the space of an hour / within a short space of time / in the space of three years
senses.example: In the [[space]] of ten years, the quiet fishing village grew into a busy tourist town.
senses.example_zh: 在短短十年的時間內，這個寧靜的漁村發展成了熱鬧的觀光小鎮。
senses.note: 常用 in the space of＋時間

senses.en: to be caused by or develop from something
senses.pattern: stem from sth / stem from a lack of sth / stem largely from sth
senses.example: Many of his health problems [[stem]] from years of poor sleep and too little exercise.
senses.example_zh: 他的許多健康問題都源自多年的睡眠不足和缺乏運動。
senses.note: 恆與 from 連用，不用進行式

senses.en: to stop something from spreading or increasing
senses.pattern: stem the spread of sth / stem the flow of sth / stem the tide of sth
senses.example: The government closed schools for two weeks to [[stem]] the spread of the virus.
senses.example_zh: 政府停課兩週，以遏止病毒擴散。

gsat.sentence: Some see it as a celebration related to the turn of the seasons from winter to spring; others, however, believe that it [[stems]] from the adoption of a new calendar.
The absence of smiles [[stemmed]] partly from the attempt to hide their decayed teeth caused by poor dental hygiene.

senses.en: to fill something tightly, or push something into a space
senses.pattern: stuff A with B / stuff sth into a bag / be stuffed with sth / a stuffed toy
senses.example: He [[stuffed]] his dirty clothes into a backpack and ran to catch the last bus home.
senses.example_zh: 他把髒衣服塞進背包，然後跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。
senses.note: I'm stuffed. 表示「我吃撐了」

gsat.sentence: According to the legend, notes of secret plans for a revolution to overthrow the Mongols were hidden in mooncakes that would ordinarily have been [[stuffed]] with sweet bean paste.

senses.en: a person or people with a natural ability
senses.pattern: attract top talent / young talent / local talent / a talent scout
senses.example: Tech companies offer high salaries and flexible hours to attract young [[talent]] from around the world.
senses.example_zh: 科技公司提供高薪和彈性工時，以吸引來自世界各地的年輕人才。
senses.note: 泛指人才時多作不可數名詞

gsat.sentence: Interviewer: You’re the older brother of Rahm, the mayor of Chicago, and Ari, an extremely successful [[talent]] agent.

senses.en: a language
senses.pattern: mother tongue / native tongue / a foreign tongue
senses.example: The old songs are sung in a [[tongue]] that only a few village elders still understand.
senses.example_zh: 這些古老的歌謠是用一種只有少數村中長者還聽得懂的語言唱的。
senses.note: mother tongue 即「母語」

gsat.sentence: People who learned a second language later in life used a special part of Broca’s area for their second language—near the one activated for their native [[tongue]].

senses.en: including or covering many different parts or groups
senses.pattern: an umbrella term / an umbrella organization / an umbrella group
senses.example: “Seafood” is an [[umbrella]] term that covers fish, shrimp, crabs, and many other sea animals.
senses.example_zh: 「海鮮」是個總括的名稱，涵蓋魚、蝦、蟹和許多其他海洋動物。
senses.note: under the umbrella of 在…的統籌或保護下

senses.en: to come safely through a difficult period
senses.pattern: weather the storm / weather a crisis / weather the recession
senses.example: Thanks to loyal customers, the small bookstore [[weathered]] the economic downturn and is still open today.
senses.example_zh: 多虧忠實顧客的支持，這家小書店平安度過了經濟衰退，至今仍在營業。
senses.note: weather the storm 常作比喻

senses.en: to change in color or shape through sun, wind, and rain
senses.pattern: weathered rock / a weathered face / be weathered by wind and rain
senses.example: Centuries of wind and rain have [[weathered]] the stone statues until their faces can hardly be seen.
senses.example_zh: 數百年的風吹雨打使這些石像風化，臉部幾乎已看不清楚。
senses.note: 形容詞 weathered 飽經風霜的

quiz.stem: Even after food prices rose sharply, the restaurant ______ its agreement with the school and kept supplying lunches at the original price.
quiz.explain_zh: honor＝履行（協議）。食材漲價後，餐廳仍守約照原價供應學校午餐。

quiz.stem: Many residents were angry that they had no ______ in the decision to cut down the old trees along their street.
quiz.explain_zh: say＝發言權。居民氣憤自己對砍除路樹的決定毫無置喙餘地。

quiz.stem: Mr. Lin is so ______ about cleanliness that he wipes his desk three times a day and never lets anyone borrow his pen.
quiz.explain_zh: particular＝講究的。林先生很重視清潔，一天擦三次桌子，筆也不外借。

quiz.stem: Volunteers piled up thousands of sandbags along the riverbank in an attempt to ______ the flow of muddy water into the town.
quiz.explain_zh: stem＝遏止。志工沿河岸堆沙包，設法阻擋泥水流入鎮上。

quiz.stem: The ancient wall paintings, left open to the ______ for centuries, have lost most of their color to sun, wind, and rain.
quiz.explain_zh: element＝（複數）風雨。古壁畫數百年來任憑日曬風吹雨淋，色彩大多褪去。

quiz.stem: Opened only last year, the city library ______ a rooftop garden, a 3D-printing lab, and more than half a million books.
quiz.explain_zh: boast＝擁有（值得自豪之物）。新圖書館有屋頂花園、3D 列印室和五十多萬冊藏書。

quiz.stem: Letting teenagers use smartphones in bed is a ______ for poor sleep, as the bright screens keep their brains awake long after midnight.
quiz.explain_zh: recipe＝（導致某結果的）因素。讓青少年在床上滑手機，必然造成睡眠不佳。

quiz.stem: The rescue robot is designed to ______ stairs, piles of broken concrete, and other obstacles that would stop an ordinary wheeled machine.
quiz.explain_zh: negotiate＝順利通過（難行處）。救難機器人能越過樓梯、瓦礫堆等障礙。

quiz.stem: Laboratory tests showed that the chemical ______ of the water in the two rivers is quite different, which explains why different fish live in them.
quiz.explain_zh: makeup＝組成。化驗顯示兩條河河水的化學組成不同，所以魚種也不同。

quiz.stem: Under the school's privacy rules, teachers cannot share a student's grades with anyone outside the family without the ______ consent of the parents.
quiz.explain_zh: express＝明確的。未經家長明確同意，老師不得把學生成績透露給外人。
